knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Separate lines show what is included and avoid disputes on the day.
The client needs to see the terms before agreeing and paying.
The artist does not control the event timing, so the quote states the time on site and the extra-time rule.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a booking brief and checks that the candidate produces a quote with separate lines for services, trial, travel and fees
Assessor checks that the cancellation term is written in plain words and shown before the deposit
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate quotes a permanent or skin-penetrating service
The candidate takes a deposit before the terms are shown
